# Thrive

> A workspace for freelancers and small studios: clients, proposals, contracts, invoices, emails, time, forms, scheduling and workflows, connected. Open source (MIT): host it yourself for free from https://github.com/lucasdidier/thrive, or use Thrive Cloud for $10 a month or $100 a year after a 7-day free trial. Every feature is in both.

Thrive suits people who sell projects, packages or hourly work. It doesn't take online payments yet, and it has no shared team workspaces yet.

## Connect an AI assistant

- MCP server: https://app.runonthrive.com/mcp
- Works with assistants that support MCP, including Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex. The user signs in to Thrive in their browser.
- Agents act with the user's access. They preview changes before saving, and email or calendar invites need the user's explicit OK.
